main_measure.name: mean excess 7-bar forward return of grid cases with forecast > 0 (vs coin's mean 7-bar return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and Spearman > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Spearman correlation between forecast and excess 7-bar return

reading: grid bars at positions 0,7,14,... of each window with a full 7-bar forward return inside the window; the coin's mean 7-bar return is the mean over that grid of all its windows; the day-clustered t uses per-day sums of deviations with a D/(D-1) correction; minimum counts are reported as 'not observable'.
